values.name: login request
values.value: JSON {username,password}, Content-Type application/json, NO Authorization header
values.source: DEX Lzaf;->e bytecode (no Basic header instruction)

values.name: ws ticket response key
values.source: DEX Lpx3;->d: firstString key is exactly 'ticket'

values.name: ws ticket errors
values.value: 401/403 -> 'WebSocket ticket request returned HTTP <n>'; other -> 'The agent is asleep.'

values.name: ws subprotocol ticket prefix
values.source: DEX Lco6;->W @0x4b-0x53; sig IS the ticket

values.name: heartbeat frame
values.value: {jsonrpc, id:'heartbeat-<n>', method:gateway.ping|ping, params:{}}; id is string counter

values.name: heartbeat interval
values.source: DEX Lco6;->B delays Ldo6;->i @008c/0098; Ldo6;-><init> @005d const-wide/16 0x3a98 (caller Lfr6;->y @00c4)

values.name: heartbeat send rule
values.value: ack-gated: ack flag F set on heartbeat JSON-RPC response (Lco6;->H @0072); tick with F set resets misses and skips send (B @00a9-00b7)

values.name: heartbeat miss watchdog
values.source: DEX Lco6;->B threshold max(1, Ldo6;->j/i)=45000/15000 @0077-007e; Len6;->invokeSuspend @0073-0084 throws 'No frame from Hermes for N heartbeat intervals' -> Lco6;->k reconnect

values.name: RPC timeout
values.source: DEX Lco6;->w()J @0x4 min(0x2710, Ldo6;->f=15000); timeout arg of g(...) in J/L/O/R/V/q (q @00e3)

values.name: ping negotiation
values.value: gateway.ready payload flag true -> gateway.ping, false -> ping

values.name: reconnect replay method
values.value: session.events.since{session_id, since=last_seq} per pending session, TreeMap order

values.name: reconnect backoff
values.source: clone policy; official cadence constant not located
